option_relations.rationale: Bacterial myositis is a broader category that includes pyomyositis, which is the specific condition described in the vignette and is caused by bacteria like F. necrophorum.
Deep neck space infection is a broader anatomical classification. The specific infection described in the vignette (intramuscular abscess of the levator scapulae) is a type of deep neck infection.

Pyomyositis of the levator scapulae muscle caused by Fusobacterium necrophorum is a specific diagnosis that aligns perfectly with the findings in the vignette, which describes an intramuscular abscess in the levator scapulae muscle and F. necrophorum infection. This is essentially a more detailed description of 'Deep neck infection due to F. necrophorum'.

Cervical intramuscular abscess (levator scapulae) due to F. necrophorum is a specific diagnosis that aligns perfectly with the findings in the vignette, which describes an intramuscular abscess in the levator scapulae muscle and F. necrophorum infection. This is essentially a more detailed description of 'Deep neck infection due to F. necrophorum'.
